title: Work Service Picture Book
hook: Service works when the right person handles the right part.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D community-helper storybook, respectful everyday service scenes, clear foregrounds; visual identity: Work Service Picture Book

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading service case pages
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Work Service Picture Book a public-service casebook: each page starts with a need—health, food, mail, sanitation, justice, rescue, transport, information—and identifies the role that can address part of it.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: The child learns that service starts from a need and that some needs require multiple roles or emergency systems.
